name: com.personality-test-free/colortype
title: ColorType personality test
description: Free four-colour workplace personality test in the chat: 21 questions, result, colour profiles.

tools.name: get_test
tools.description: The 21 questions of the free ColorType personality test (workplace behaviour, DISC-style four colours), each with options a-d, in the person's language. Ask them one at a time.

lang.description: Language code, e.g. en, de, fr, es, it, nl, pt, pl, ja, zh

tools.name: submit_test
tools.description: Score the person's answers. Returns their main and second colour with percentages, a short profile and result_page (their full result, with the detailed report offered there).

answers.description: Every question id from get_test mapped to the chosen letter a-d

lang.description: Language code, e.g. en, de, fr, es, it, nl, pt, pl, ja, zh

tools.name: get_color_profile
tools.description: Traits, strengths, watch-outs, communication style, motivators and stressors of one colour.

lang.description: Language code, e.g. en, de, fr, es, it, nl, pt, pl, ja, zh

tools.name: compare_colors
tools.description: What works well and where friction comes from when two colours work or live together.

lang.description: Language code, e.g. en, de, fr, es, it, nl, pt, pl, ja, zh
